clients.subOauth: Paste the URL and authorize. No API key needed.

claude.step1: In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, open Settings → Connectors.
claude.step3: Paste the URL above as the connector URL, then click "Add".
claude.step4: Click "Connect" and sign in with mcpemails to authorize. No API key needed.

chatgpt.step1: Open Settings → Apps & Connectors → Advanced settings and turn on Developer mode.
chatgpt.step3: Enter a name and paste the URL above as the Connector URL.
chatgpt.step4: Pick OAuth, click "Create", then authorize with mcpemails.
chatgpt.note: Full MCP is a beta limited to ChatGPT Business and Enterprise/Edu workspaces.

cursor.step3: Cursor prompts you to sign in via OAuth. Authorize with mcpemails.

vscode.step1: Open the Command Palette (⇧⌘P) and run "MCP: Add Server".
vscode.step2: Choose "HTTP", paste the URL above, and give it a name.
vscode.step3: Start the server from the MCP view and authorize when prompted.

cline.step1: In the Cline panel, click the MCP Servers icon, then open the "Remote Servers" tab.
cline.step2: Enter a name and paste the URL above.
cline.step3: Set Transport Type to "Streamable HTTP", then click "Add Server".
cline.step4: Add an "Authorization: Bearer <key>" header using your API key.

windsurf.step1: Open Cascade’s MCP settings, or edit ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json.
windsurf.step2: Add the server below. Note the field is "serverUrl", not "url".
windsurf.step3: Refresh MCP servers in Cascade and authorize with mcpemails when prompted.

gemini.step2: Add the server below under "mcpServers" using the "httpUrl" field.
gemini.step3: On first connect the CLI auto-discovers OAuth and opens the browser flow.

zed.step1: In the Agent Panel settings click "Add Custom Server", or edit settings.json.
zed.step3: Zed prompts the OAuth flow when no Authorization header is set. Sign in with mcpemails.

jetbrains.step1: Open Settings → Tools → AI Assistant → Model Context Protocol (MCP).
jetbrains.step2: Click "Add" and select "Streamable HTTP" as the connection type.
jetbrains.step3: Paste the URL above, then add an "Authorization: Bearer <key>" header with your API key.

raycast.step1: Run the "Install MCP Server" command (or "Manage MCP Servers").
raycast.step2: Enter a name, set Transport to "HTTP", and paste the URL above.
raycast.step3: Press "Install MCP Server", then click "Sign In" to authorize with mcpemails.

warp.step1: Open Settings → Agents → MCP servers and click "+ Add".
warp.step2: Select the "Streamable HTTP or SSE Server (URL)" tab.
warp.step3: Paste the URL above and confirm, then complete browser OAuth when prompted.

api.step1: Create an API key in Dashboard → API Keys, then copy it (shown only once).
api.step2: Send requests to the URL above with an Authorization: Bearer header.
